svg.text: A case only closes when evidence confirms it: every state change is a service call that also writes an audit event.

Polls the API every 3 s. English / Hindi, A- A A+.
No auth tokens: the backend has no authentication.
API routers (thin: validate, call a service, commit once)
Service layer: state change + Event in one transaction
unit of state, one per department
also POST /admin/tick and on clock jumps
Reopen (citizen says no, bad evidence, or a new report after closure): back to OPEN with a shorter SLA; the 2nd reopen forces escalation to Department Head. SLA breach: escalate one level and re-arm.
